newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH LG ELECTRONICS SEES $25 MLN SALES 1997.
newsitem.headline: POLISH LG ELECTRONICS SEES $25 MLN SALES 1997.

text.p: The Polish unit of South Korea's LG Electronics, which started operating on Wednesday, expects its 1997 sales at $25 million and sees them rising to $60 million next year, the firm's trade director said.
"Although we begin our operations only in June, we expect our sales to amount to $25 million and next year to $60 million," Jan Juraszek told a news conference.
The president of the firm Weon Dae Kim, also present, said LG Electronics was also considering building a TV sets factory, but said further details would be available late this year.
The company wants to sell computer equipment, audio-video, household appliances and telecommunication equipment in Poland.
